# Subdomain Takeover Checker

> Free tool: paste a hostname and it follows its real CNAME chain, then -- if the chain ends at a known takeover-prone provider (S3, Heroku, GitHub Pages, Azure, and 20 more) -- sends one live GET request and checks the response against that provider's own 'nothing is claimed at this name' page.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
